title: Queen's jam

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: A Queen's jam is a Black Forest-tier food.

sections.heading: Recipe
sections.text:
Four Queen's jams are produced in a level 1 Cauldron with:
• 8 Raspberries
• 6 Blueberries

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Queen's jam provides the second-highest stamina gain in the Black Forest at 40, second to Carrot soup at 45.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Queen's jam is a popular jam in Scandinavia, made by mixing raspberries and blueberries, both sweet and common, in the region.
• Drottningsylt, or queen’s jam, is popular for delicacies such as plättar and Swedish pancakes.
